versions.changelog:
Initial release of chip-distribution skill:

- Provides cost distribution (筹码分布), concentration, trapped funds, support and resistance analysis using 东方财富 CYQ data.
- Activates on key terms like “筹码分布”, “筹码集中度”, “成本密集区”, “套牢盘”, and “低位密集”.
- Explains core concepts: cost range positions, concentration levels (CYQKKD), and profit/loss ratio (CYS).
- Offers typical chip pattern signals and related trading operations.
- Describes support/resistance calculations based on chip distribution.
- Includes reference to detailed analysis documentation.
